new_libraries.name: EnigmaIoT
new_libraries.author: Rahmat Purnomo
new_libraries.sentence: Connect ESP32 / ESP8266 to the Enigma IoT platform: realtime dashboard, virtual pins, MQTT, OTA updates and WiFi setup portal.
new_libraries.paragraph: Library resmi Enigma IoT (platform IoT Indonesia). Kirim data sensor dan terima perintah dari dashboard lewat MQTT dengan virtual pin (V0-V255), update firmware lewat WiFi (OTA), portal WiFi (atur WiFi & token dari HP), peta GPS, kamera ESP32-CAM, serta widget sensor DHT, MPU6050, radar, gas, dan ketinggian.

new_libraries.name: esp_new_jpeg
new_libraries.author: Espressif Systems
new_libraries.sentence: Espressif JPEG encoder and decoder for ESP32-S3 (prebuilt binary, Arduino packaging).
new_libraries.paragraph: Arduino packaging of the Espressif esp_new_jpeg component v1.0.2. Provides JPEG decode (esp_jpeg_dec) and encode (esp_jpeg_enc) for ESP32 / ESP32-S3. The prebuilt static libraries are taken unmodified from the upstream component; this repository only adds Arduino library metadata, documentation and examples.
